<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def gpos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<=8:
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
def redstate(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']==24:
            b=n['boundary']; return 'vert' if (max(p[0] for p in b)-min(p[0] for p in b))>4 else 'horiz'
def bluepos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; c=min(p[1] for p in b)
            if c<32: return (min(p[0] for p in b),c)
def chk(tag):
    g=gpos(current_frame); r=redstate(current_frame); b=bluepos(current_frame)
    done=last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
    print(tag,"g=",g,"red=",r,"blue=",b,"done=",done)
    return done
print("start:",gpos(current_frame),redstate(current_frame),bluepos(current_frame))
# move green (42,12) -> center (40,10)
action(['UP']); action(['LEFT'])
chk("center")

# branch 4: red=horiz, blue=(34,8)

</parameter>

def gpos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<=8:
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
def redstate(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']==24:
            b=n['boundary']; return 'vert' if (max(p[0] for p in b)-min(p[0] for p in b))>4 else 'horiz'
def bluepos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; c=min(p[1] for p in b)
            if c<32: return (min(p[0] for p in b),c)
def chk(tag):
    g=gpos(current_frame); r=redstate(current_frame); b=bluepos(current_frame)
    done=last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('run_complete')
    print(tag,"g=",g,"red=",r,"blue=",b,"done=",done)
    return done
